envelope.description: Prove a no-Plan Story can complete through the existing gate and run the affected suites

body.title: Prove a no-Plan Story can complete through the existing gate and run the affected suites
body.summary: Add the end-to-end case where a derived-unit review of a no-Plan Story reaches a passing whole-story record and inspectTaskCompletion passes, plus the negative cases where it does not; then run the task-review, daemon task-review and workflow-gate suites once, in the foreground by area, and record the result.
acceptanceChecks: A passing whole-story review of a derived unit lets inspectTaskCompletion pass, and a task-only, non-passing or stale-fingerprint review does not
The task-review, daemon task-review and workflow-gate suites pass, with any failure compared against a clean base checkout
